name: bopvpob-leaderboard
description: Global leaderboard API for Balloon of Pee vs. Platoon of Bees (Cloudflare Worker + D1).

scripts.scores: wrangler d1 execute bopvpob-leaderboard --remote --command "SELECT id, name, score_tenths / 10.0 AS seconds, created_at FROM scores ORDER BY score_tenths DESC LIMIT 50"
